wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap relation 6635 fixes the original 64-vertex main envelope. Its eight- and twelve-vertex inner ways fix Linnanpiha and Halkopiha. Mapped node 319771993 fixes the principal door.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the tall granite and copper tower, main stair, varied steep roofs, open Linnanpiha and Halkopiha, and round turrets. Closer levels add door surrounds, dormer trim and windows.
limitations: The original outline, courtyard openings and main entrance are mapped. The historic roof sections, minor turret positions, bay widths and statue relief are proportional estimates informed by the 2012 photographs.

The tower height is based on the museum’s 58-meter published dimension. The source terrain is unchanged. Original provider elevations include likely canopy and roof effects, and local thresholds and foundations are approximate.
The scope is the historic exterior and two courtyards in 2012. The later addition and interior galleries are outside scope.
